question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT ra.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id, ra.round
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
last_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MAX(round) AS last_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN first_round fr ON rd.year = fr.year AND rd.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND rd.round = fr.first_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
last_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN last_round lr ON rd.year = lr.year AND rd.driver_id = lr.driver_id AND rd.round = lr.last_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
round_counts AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS num_rounds
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.year, fc.driver_id, fc.constructor_id AS first_constructor, lc.constructor_id AS last_constructor, rc.num_rounds
    FROM first_constructor fc
    JOIN last_constructor lc ON fc.year = lc.year AND fc.driver_id = lc.driver_id
    JOIN round_counts rc ON fc.year = rc.year AND fc.driver_id = rc.driver_id
    WHERE fc.constructor_id = lc.constructor_id
      AND rc.num_rounds >= 2
)
